'''Hugo''' was an armored [[exoboar]] used by the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. It was killed during the [[Dantooine Incursion]]<ref name="Hugo" /> in [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" />
